markup.[[x]]: 重点形式：这个语法要你注意的词（橙底）
markup.{x}: 变化的部分：只用在 [[ ]] 里，例如 work{s}（橙底里加粗下划线）
markup.((x)): 变回原形的动词（虚线下划线）
markup.~~x~~: 错句里错的部分（删除线）

idea.title: 一句话说清
idea.text: 不知道是谁、是什么、在哪儿时，用这些词。它们像**拼积木**：前半截 some、any、no、every 管「多少」，后半截 one 是人、thing 是东西、where 是地方。

uses.en: [[Someone]] left a comment on your PR.
uses.en_zh: 有人在你的 PR 上留了评论。

uses.en: My keys are [[nowhere]] to be found.
uses.en_zh: 我的钥匙哪儿都找不到。

build.title: 拼积木
build.rule: 四个前半截 × 三个后半截，拼出 12 个词。人还可以用 -body：someone = somebody，意思一样。

rules.change: 否定句、问句；或者「随便哪个」

build.tip: no one 要分开写成两个词，其他的都连在一起写。

choose.title: some、any、no 怎么选
choose.rule: 和 some、any 一样：肯定句用 some-，否定句、问句用 any-。英语一句话**只能有一个「不」**：要么 didn't + anything，要么 nothing。

examples.en: I didn't see [[anyone]] in the office.
I saw [[no one]] in the office.
examples.zh: 我在办公室一个人都没看到。

examples.en: Where shall we eat? [[Anywhere]] is fine.

notes: any- 用在肯定句里，意思是「**随便哪个都行**」。
请别人或者希望对方说 yes 的问句，用 some-：Would you like [[something]] to drink?

singular.title: 当一个来用
singular.rule: everyone 虽然是「大家」，语法上却当**一个人**来用，动词要加 s。不过回头说「他们的」时，用 they、their。

examples.en: [[Someone]] left [[their]] umbrella in the meeting room.
examples.zh: 有人把伞落在会议室了。

after.title: 后面还能加什么
after.rule: 形容词要放在这些词**后面**，和中文反过来：「新的东西」= something **new**。还常加 else（别的）和 to do（可以做的）。

items.en: I've got [[nothing to do]] at the weekend.

commonMistakes.why: everyone 当一个人用，动词加 s。
nobody 已经是「不」了，不用再加 didn't。

quiz.explain: 说地方用 -where，否定句用 any-：[[anywhere]]。

quiz.prompt: There's ___ at the door. Can you check?
改错：I didn't see nobody in the office.
quiz.answer: I didn't see anybody in the office.
accept: I didn't see anyone in the office.
I saw nobody in the office.
I saw no one in the office.

quiz.prompt: Is there ___ I can do to help?
改成否定句：I've got something to say.
quiz.answer: I haven't got anything to say.
accept: I have not got anything to say.
I don't have anything to say.

traps.input: I haven't got nothing to say.
traps.note: 已经有 haven't 了，后面用 anything。

quiz.prompt: — Where shall we eat? — ___ is fine. I'm not fussy.
quiz.explain: 肯定句里的 any- 是「随便哪个都行」：[[Anywhere]]。

quiz.prompt: 改错：Everybody are here, so let's start.
quiz.answer: Everybody is here, so let's start.

quiz.prompt: Someone left ___ umbrella in the meeting room.
翻译：这个周末我没什么事做。
quiz.answer: I've got nothing to do this weekend.
accept: I have nothing to do this weekend.
I have got nothing to do this weekend.
I don't have anything to do this weekend.
I haven't got anything to do this weekend.

quiz.prompt: This task is easy. ___ can do it.
改错：Nobody didn't come to the meeting.
accept: No one came to the meeting.

quiz.prompt: ___ of the tests passed. Not a single one failed.
quiz.explain: 说东西「每一个」，分开写：[[Every one]] of。

openTask.prompt: 用 3 句话说说你上周末或者今天在公司的情况。至少用到一个 some- 词、一个 any- 词，和一个 no- 或 every- 词。
rules: 否定句和疑问句用 any-，不和 not 叠用 no-
everyone / nobody 等做主语时动词用单数
形容词和 else 放在不定代词后面
openTask.note: 规则判不定代词和动词单复数（计分）；离线模型给更自然的说法（AI 建议，不计分）
